[table] [tr][td][url=https://discord.gg/h5TY6DA][img]https://i.postimg.cc/T1h9SjbF/Discord.png[/img][/url][/td] [td][url=https://github.com/emipa606/TeleportationTrap][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fykKF7X4/Github.png[/img][/url][/td] [/tr] [tr] [td][img]https://i.postimg.cc/MHXD40RW/Safe-To-Add.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://i.postimg.cc/brdTM0bP/Remove-May-Work.png[/img][/td] [/tr] [/table]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hvhrw8xB/Original-Description.png[/img] [h3]A marvel of frontier ingenuity and sadism, this security device teleports enemies to or from a linked teleportation trap. Use it to send drifters to your den of thrumbos or streamline raids by delivering enemies straight to the oven.[/h3]
While chemfuel provides the raw power, psychite tea refines and amplifies psychic energy to isolate and project a target's physical form. When triggered, it locks onto an intruder’s signature and violently ejects them to the designated location.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cHrMQhRd/pXZimqS.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr] [h3]How To Use[/h3] [list] [*]Unlock with [b]Psychoid Brewing[/b] research. [*]Build from the [b]Security[/b] menu. [*][b]Costs[/b]: 30 steel, 10 chemfuel, and 1 psychite tea per trap. [*][b]Link traps via the interface menu[/b]. [list][*]Without a linked trap, it functions as a single-use trap and loses its teleportation ability. To preserve its functionality, either link it to another trap or uninstall it.[/list] [*][b]When triggered[/b]: [list] [*]The enemy is teleported to the linked trap. [*]Both traps are consumed upon use.[/list][/list]
[hr][/hr] [h3]Additional Functionality[/h3] [img]https://i.postimg.cc/hGC1z67x/xVRZJ2f.png[/img] [list] [*][b]Link, unlink, or relink[/b] traps from either trap’s interface menu. [list][*]Linked pairs display a green line when selected. [*]Unlinked traps show a yellow question mark when selected. [*]Unlinking or relinking removes previous connections. [/list][*][b]Toggle teleportation mode[/b]: [list] [*][b]Enabled + Linked[/b]: Teleports enemies to the linked trap and receives enemies from it. Both traps are consumed. [*][b]Disabled + Linked[/b]: Receives teleported enemies only, without triggering on contact. Both traps are consumed. [*][b]Unlinked[/b]: Functions as a single-use spike trap with no teleportation. [/list] [*]Customize [b]glow color[/b] (requires Advanced Lights research). [*]Colonists and animals are unaffected by teleportation traps.[/list]
[hr][/hr] [h3][b]Compatibility[/b][/h3] [list] [*][b]Game Version:[/b] RimWorld 1.5+. [*][b]Mod Conflicts:[/b] None known. [/list]
[hr][/hr] [h3][b]Credits & Disclaimer[/b][/h3] [list] [*][b]Contributions:[/b] Thanks to the RimWorld community for feature suggestions and balance tweaks. [*]This mod is fan-made and not affiliated with Ludeon Studios. [/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLJjxCcN/4Wg8TVM.gif[/img] Close one, Gowing...
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/x8qR7GH9/Reporting-Issues.png[/img] [list] [*] See if the error persists if you just have this mod and its requirements active. [*] If not, try adding your other mods until it happens again. [*] Always post your log using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873415404]Log Uploader[/url] [*] For best support, please use the Discord-channel for error-reporting. [*] Do not report errors by making a discussion-thread, I get no notification of that. [*] If you have the solution for a problem, please post it to the GitHub repository. [*] Use [url=https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/releases/latest]RimSort[/url] to sort your mods [/list]
